extract_and_tokenize_code_dataset: extract data from JSON files and tokenize code lines using a parallel ProcessPoolExecutor with configurable timeout
split_train_test_valid: split tokenized code data into train, valid, and test sets with deduplication based on SHA256 content hashing
apply_bpe_to_dataset: apply Byte Pair Encoding to all tokenized dataset files across train, valid, and test splits using a submitit executor
binarize_dataset_for_xlm: binarize BPE-encoded dataset files into PyTorch .pth format for use with the XLM model training pipeline
create_xlm_symlinks: create symlinks in an XLM-syml folder that map binarized dataset files to the naming convention expected by XLM
